title: a flow condition passes record.<date field> + 1 while the same arithmetic over the bare name is refused: the date-arithmetic verdict is not applied to record./previous. reads
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-lizheng · session_012MmDsS4GoHCgYwA2uv3n3C

Filing gate: class a, an out-of-scope finding of the #34662 dev round (PR #34935, report 6955879892), measured by that dev. ⛔ Not a claim. Grading and `domain:*` are triage's.

Suggested-grade: p2 · the same family and outcome as #34662, #34451, #34363: the flow fails on every run, and authoring says nothing

## 维护者速读

- 现象：流程条件里写 `record.due_date + 1 > 5`(`due_date` 是日期字段)，`os validate` 不报任何问题，运行时每次都出错;同样的算式写成裸字段名 `due_date + 1 > 5` 会被拒。
- 为什么要修：和 #34662 是同一类问题，只是换成了「日期做加减」这一种判定。
- 需要你做的：无(分诊定级)。

## Measured (by the dev, on PR #34935's head 653f1fb45e)

`validateStackExpressions` on a record-triggered flow, object `library_loan` with `due_date: { type: date, required: true }`:

| start condition | findings |
|:---|:---|
| `due_date + 1 > 5` | 1 error (date-arithmetic, `google.protobuf.Timestamp + int`) |
| `record.due_date + 1 > 5` | 0 |
| `previous.due_date + 1 > 5` | 0 |

At run time the condition faults on `"YYYY-MM-DD" + 1`.

## Where

`packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts`: `firstTypeMismatch`'s record-root pass returns only the text/boolean mismatch (comment "The date verdicts stay the bare name's alone"). PR #34935's date-text pass deliberately stands down on this shape, because it is the date-arithmetic verdict's job, not date-text's.

## Done when

`record.DATE_FIELD + N` and `previous.DATE_FIELD + N` in a flow condition are refused like the bare name, at `os validate` and at the publish door. CONTROL: a `datetime` field.

## Notes

Lands after PR #34935 (same files).

Dedupe: `"record." date-arithmetic flow condition` (0 open).

Blocked-by: #34662
